definition: What the corpus declines to be, in its own account of itself: not the automation of the architect, not style policing, not historical reconstruction, not a compliance engine, and not complete.
basis: VISION.md, section X, the list the front door shows under this heading: "The system is built to refuse, to defer, and to present options it will not choose between.", "The corpus records what a style *does*, with its exceptions", "The code layer is advisory model text and is labelled as such." and "Several of the world's building traditions are absent"
